+import re
+
+import boto3
+
+from translation_models import normalize_markup_payload
+
+
+TAG_RE = re.compile(r"(<[^>]+>)")
+
+
+def translate_markup(payload, config=None):
+    request = normalize_markup_payload(payload)
+    client = boto3.client("translate", region_name=(config or {}).get("region"))
+    parts = TAG_RE.split(request["markup"])
+    translated_parts = []
+    for part in parts:
+        if not part or TAG_RE.fullmatch(part):
+            translated_parts.append(part)
+            continue
+        response = client.translate_text(
+            Text=part,
+            SourceLanguageCode=request["source_language"],
+            TargetLanguageCode=request["target_language"],
+        )
+        translated_parts.append(response["TranslatedText"])
+    return {
+        "markup": "".join(translated_parts),
+        "source_language": request["source_language"],
+        "target_language": request["target_language"],
+    }
+

+import os
+
+import boto3
+
+
+def get_translation_config(config=None):
+    merged = dict(config or {})
+    if "region" not in merged:
+        merged["region"] = os.environ.get("AWS_REGION") or os.environ.get("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION")
+    return merged
+
+
+def get_translate_client(config=None):
+    cfg = get_translation_config(config)
+    return boto3.client("translate", region_name=cfg.get("region"))
+
+
+def translate_text_value(client, text, source_language, target_language):
+    response = client.translate_text(
+        Text=text,
+        SourceLanguageCode=source_language,
+        TargetLanguageCode=target_language,
+    )
+    return response["TranslatedText"]
+
+
+def translate_text_with_config(text, source_language, target_language, config=None):
+    client = get_translate_client(config)
+    return translate_text_value(client, text, source_language, target_language)

+import boto3
+
+from translation_models import normalize_batch_payload, normalize_result
+
+
+def batch_translate(payload, config=None):
+    request = normalize_batch_payload(payload)
+    client = boto3.client("translate", region_name=(config or {}).get("region"))
+    texts = request["texts"]
+    source_language = request["source_language"]
+    target_language = request["target_language"]
+    output = []
+    for text in texts:
+        response = client.translate_text(
+            Text=text,
+            SourceLanguageCode=source_language,
+            TargetLanguageCode=target_language,
+        )
+        output.append(normalize_result(response["TranslatedText"], source_language, target_language))
+    return output

+import re
+
+import boto3
+
+from translation_models import normalize_markup_payload
+
+
+TAG_RE = re.compile(r"(<[^>]+>)")
+
+
+def translate_markup(payload, config=None):
+    request = normalize_markup_payload(payload)
+    client = boto3.client("translate", region_name=(config or {}).get("region"))
+    parts = TAG_RE.split(request["markup"])
+    translated_parts = []
+    for part in parts:
+        if not part or TAG_RE.fullmatch(part):
+            translated_parts.append(part)
+            continue
+        response = client.translate_text(
+            Text=part,
+            SourceLanguageCode=request["source_language"],
+            TargetLanguageCode=request["target_language"],
+        )
+        translated_parts.append(response["TranslatedText"])
+    return {
+        "markup": "".join(translated_parts),
+        "source_language": request["source_language"],
+        "target_language": request["target_language"],
+    }

+
+

+    request = normalize_dictionary_payload(payload)
+    client = boto3.client("translate", region_name=(config or {}).get("region"))
+    translated = {}

+        response = client.translate_text(
+            Text=value,
+            SourceLanguageCode=request["source_language"],
+            TargetLanguageCode=request["target_language"],
+        )
+        translated[key] = response["TranslatedText"]
+    return {

+        "source_language": request["source_language"],
+        "target_language": request["target_language"],
+    }

+    text = payload.get("text", "")

+    return {

+                "type": "sentiment",
+                "sentiment": response["Sentiment"],
+                "scores": response["SentimentScore"],
+            }
+        ],
+        "language": payload.get("language", "en"),
+    }

+
+
+def translation_memory_embedding(payload, config=None):
+    client = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime", region_name=(config or {}).get("region"))
+    model_id = payload.get("model_id", "amazon.titan-embed-text-v1")

+    response = client.invoke_model(modelId=model_id, body=str(body).replace("'", '"'))
+    return {

+        "embedding": response.get("body").read() if hasattr(response.get("body"), "read") else response.get("body"),
+    }
